interface.shortDescription: 从论文、代码和实验形成可核查的科研判断
interface.longDescription: 融合 ResearchStudio、Research Companion 与 Co-Scientist 的研究方法，按当前问题调用技能，以版本化记录保留证据、反例和决定。默认检索本机论文库与 arXiv。
defaultPrompt: 用 $research-workflow 从当前项目的问题、代码和文献开始研究。
用 $research-review 核查这个想法的关键前提与反例。
用 $research-report 生成一张简洁但有证据的 idea card。

plugin.description: Evidence-grounded research: literature and code, problem discovery, mechanism construction, testing, review and decisions.

skills.name: open-scientist:research-code
skills.description: Use when a research premise depends on implementation, data availability, evaluation logic, logs, or environment facts, or when code may explain an apparent scientific failure.

skills.name: open-scientist:research-construct
skills.description: Use when a research direction needs a concrete mechanism, implementable dataflow, explicit assumptions and estimand, fair naive baseline, or a falsifiable prediction before code or experiments are expanded.

skills.name: open-scientist:research-decide
skills.description: Use when choosing whether to pursue, refine, park, kill, pivot, or resume research, when resource or user constraints change, or when plausible alternatives need an investment choice without a forced scientific winner.

skills.name: open-scientist:research-diagnose
skills.description: Use when a research bottleneck is vague, literature and code disagree, a claimed gap may be a known solution or evaluation artifact, or new evidence changes which problem is actually being studied.

skills.name: open-scientist:research-evolve
skills.description: Use when an existing research mechanism needs repair, simplification, combination, or reframing; when a useful test is infeasible; or when repeated findings expose a shared faulty assumption.

skills.name: open-scientist:research-ideate
skills.description: Use when a grounded research question needs alternative mechanisms, cross-domain connections, challenged assumptions, or a clearer distinction between promising directions and renamed existing ideas.

skills.name: open-scientist:research-report
skills.description: Use when a research idea, experiment, competing hypotheses, or project history needs a card, overview, explanation, translation, progress report, or evidence-bounded conclusion.

skills.name: open-scientist:research-retrieve
skills.description: Use when research needs related work, a missing source, a cross-field mechanism, a baseline comparison, an unresolved citation, or evidence about a specific novelty claim at any stage.

skills.name: open-scientist:research-review
skills.description: Use when a research claim, mechanism, experiment, citation, or revision needs scrutiny; when reviewers disagree; or when favorable scores conflict with raw counterevidence.

skills.name: open-scientist:research-test
skills.description: Use when a research claim needs a discriminating experiment, executable counterexample, numerical dry run, or interpretation of completed and failed test runs.

skills.name: open-scientist:research-workflow
skills.description: Use when starting or resuming a research project, coordinating literature and code investigation, or choosing the next research action after new evidence or feedback.
